jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Governance (Identity & Auth)
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

We're seeking a Director, Product Management to join our Governance team. You'll drive product direction across human and agent identity, delegated and scoped authorization, credential brokering, audit and attribution for non-human actors (agents), and the emerging patterns the industry is still inventing including agent-to-agent auth, MCP auth, OAuth flows for autonomous callers, just-in-time elevation, sandboxing, policy-as-code for tool access and more.



This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You will not be running status meetings. You will be deep in the product: testing, prototyping with coding agents, talking to customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers building it. Influence, not headcount, will your default leverage.



Your north star will be enterprise trust translating into adoption: governance strict enough for the most regulated customers, and frictionless enough that builders don't route around it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 -  Own the multi-year vision for identity, auth, and access governance across UiPath's agentic platform.

 - Evolve how identity (for agents, robots and humans) works at UiPath (provisioning, scoping, delegation, attestation, rotation, revocation) and set the patterns the rest of the platform builds on.

 - Drive the auth model for tool-calling and MCP: scoped consent, least-privilege execution, and audit trails that hold up in front of a compliance team.

 - Partner with the largest and most regulated customers (financial services, healthcare, public sector) on production deployments. Go deep enough to know which specific control failed and what would fix it.

 - Use the platform as a builder. Self-host, stand up agents, wire up auth flows, use coding agents aggressively to prototype and ship reference implementations. If you need a working example to make a point, build one.

 - Translate emerging standards (delegated OAuth for agents, verifiable credentials, MCP auth, policy engines like OPA/Cedar) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.

 - Define the metrics that matter (e.g. time-to-grant, audit coverage, policy violations caught, developer friction) and prioritize ruthlessly.

 - Represent UiPath's governance story externally with customers, partners, and industry forums. Build the credibility that makes CISOs say yes.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 10+ years in technical PM or eng roles with specific emphasis on security engineering, identity/IAM platform work, or technical GTM. Proven track record of shipping infrastructure enterprises trust.

 - Deep fluency in identity and auth: OAuth 2.x/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, JWT, mTLS, secrets management, RBAC/ABAC, policy engines, audit and SIEM integration. You can read an auth flow and immediately see what's wrong with it.

 - Working understanding of agentic AI (tool-calling, MCP, RAG, agent design patterns) and a clear view on how identity must evolve to support autonomous actors.

 - Builder posture, AI-native. You write code (or prompt agents to) to test ideas and ship prototypes. You treat coding agents as leverage. You do not simply write specs or decks and wait.

 - First-principles thinker, comfortable in ambiguity. Can produce a defensible direction in days, not quarters.

 - Sharp communicator: a position doc that inspires bold decisions, a technical explanation a CISO trusts, a demo that closes the room.

 - Comfortable with regulated, on-prem, and hybrid environments.
   
   


IDEAL BACKGROUND:

 - Shipped identity, auth, or security-platform products at a frontier lab, hyperscaler identity team, IAM vendor (Okta, Auth0, Entra, Ping), or as an early PM at a startup in the space.

 - Has gone 0 → 1 and felt the weight of it. Startup or founding PM style experience strongly preferred.

 - Has opinions about where agent identity is going in the next 24 months, with receipts.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

Senior Technical Program Manager - US Public Sector

Your mission

You'll own UiPath’s US public sector compliance portfolio and drive strategy, coordination and execution across compliance initiatives such as FedRAMP HIGH, CMMC, IL5 and related DoD requirements, CJIS, GovRAMP and other state related obligations. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can take ambiguous, high-stakes public sector requirements and turn them into a clear, actionable plan, then drive that plan across engineering, compliance, and external stakeholders until it's done. Success here means fewer surprises for dependent teams, faster audit and assessment cycles, and a public sector product roadmap that keeps pace with a fast-moving business.



What You'll Own

• Own the technical roadmap for expanding UiPath's product footprint under the Public Sector umbrella, translating complex, ambiguous public sector requirements into concrete engineering and compliance work-streams.

• Own the relationship between internal engineering teams and external stakeholders, designing solutions that proactively reduce compliance overhead on dependent teams instead of pushing work downstream.

• Own key technical work-streams in support of the public sector compliance team, evaluating and strengthening processes, procedures, operating environment, and people readiness across new and ongoing audits, assessments, and regulatory initiatives.

• Coordinate with GRC engineering function to automate your way through manual processes such as POAM and promote continuous monitoring across the infrastructure

• Own and support other international compliance obligations, such as ISMAP and IRAP.

What You Bring

• U.S. Citizenship (required for this role).

• 6-8 years owning the implementation of technical requirements, continuous monitoring, and external audits within U.S. public sector frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP HIGH, CMMC).

• A proven track record owning a Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) program for large, complex environments.

• Direct experience driving the FedRAMP significant change request process from initiation through closure.

• A record of driving outcomes with distributed teams across time zones, with the collaboration skills to bring people along and the judgment to know when to lead and when to defer.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on development experience.

• Experience working with DoD, intelligence, and/or government contractors.

jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

YOUR MISSION

Shape the future of agentic automation: UiPath is evolving from RPA to the worldʼs first Agentic Orchestration platform, enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents at scale. As part of this transformation, Peak (a UiPath company) is building new B2B agentic solutions that deliver immediate, measurable business value. Youʼll play a pivotal role in shaping and growing one of these solutions.

As a Principal Product Manager for one of our supply chain and/or manufacturing agentic solution areas, youʼll define how applied AI and automation combine to create measurable value in complex B2B domains such as supply planning, commercial operations and inventory optimization. Youʼll join a high-performing, cross-functional team building next-generation products in a rapidly evolving space where innovation, learning, and impact are daily drivers. Youʼll identify and prioritize the most valuable product opportunities, lead discovery and delivery, and work across Peak and UiPath teams to bring transformative solutions to life. From influencing go-to-market strategy to driving customer adoption, youʼll own the product vision for your area that excites and motivates our teams and delivers significant commercial impact.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Define and drive an inspiring vision for one of Peakʼs agentic solution areas in supply chain or manufacturing, aligning to UiPathʼs broader strategic aims and the evolving agentic landscape

 - Bring deep credibility and domain expertise to customer and commercial conversations, steering sales, roadmap and design partnerships to maximise customer value

 - Own the roadmap for your area, making challenging tradeoff decisions for complex, ambiguous problems

 - Engage with our customers and the market to understand their needs, validate strategy and use cases, and ultimately drive amazing outcomes for our customers

 - Deeply understand the technical reality of our solution, anchoring our go-to-market motions to product truth

 - Lead product launches, enable sales teams to sell your solution and drive revenue growth in your areas of responsibility

 - Collaborate with and elevate the broader product team through knowledge sharing, thought leadership and mentoring




WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Typically 8+ years in product management, including significant experience leading strategic initiatives in a SaaS product business

 - Strong domain expertise in supply chain and/or manufacturing.

 - Deep experience with AI/ML/agentic products, and the ability to effectively navigate the technical complexity and rapidly evolving landscape characteristic of these products

 - Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional colleagues, including sales, marketing, professional services and engineering teams

 - Excellent stakeholder management across all levels of seniority, both within our business and within our customerʼs businesses

 - A highly effective strategic thinker, able to solve strategic problems creatively and pragmatically and drive disciplined execution across relevant teams off the back of it

 - Proven experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software. Particularly desirable: experience in supply chain, pricing, procurement, ERP, or adjacent enterprise software domains.


Youʼll join a team that values clarity, autonomy, and experimentation — where weʼre building the future of agentic automation, together.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic Orchestration & Automation
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



As a Product Manager for Agentic Business Orchestration & Automation, you will drive the evolution of how enterprises design, deploy, and govern multi-agent systems that execute end-to-end business processes. You will own a critical surface of the platform — where AI agents, deterministic robots, APIs, and humans are composed into reliable, auditable, business-grade workflows.

You will work closely and spend significant time with enterprise customers and internal users to prioritize requirements and ship improvements that keep UiPath ahead of frontier model capabilities and positioned as the most trusted way to put agents to work in production. You will also collaborate daily with engineering and GTM teams.

In just the past year, agentic automation has redefined what's possible inside the enterprise — and we're only scratching the surface. As model intelligence accelerates, the ultimate form factor for orchestrating agents alongside humans and deterministic systems remains unwritten. We're looking for a PM who combines deep technical understanding, genuine empathy for operators and developers, and strong product intuition. You should be equally comfortable debugging an agent trace with engineers, prototyping, enabling GTM teams, walking through a process with a Fortune 500 COO, and presenting strategy to executives.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Define the roadmap for an area of the Agentic Orchestration product suite — agent runtime, planner/router, human-in-the-loop, governance, or process composition.

 - Translate cutting-edge advances in reasoning, tool use, and long-horizon planning into practical, governable enterprise features.

 - Build the ecosystem around agents, processes, and connectors so customers and partners can easily share, reuse, and scale agentic patterns.

 - Operate as an AI-multiplied PM: leverage AI to synthesize customer signals, draft specs, prototype flows, and run evaluations — compressing the cycle from insight to shipped feature.

 - Move closer to GTM: own competitive positioning, partner with PMM on messaging, collaborate with forward deployed engineers, echo learnings, and stay directly engaged with customer success and field teams on adoption and expansion.

 - Define and own the metrics that matter — task success rate, intervention rate, cost-per-completion, time-to-value — and use them to drive prioritization.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 4 years combined experience in product management and software engineering

 - Technical background, contributing to the shipping of technical products cross-functionally with engineering and applied AI/research teams.

 - Track record of contributing to ambitious products with distribution or commercial success — enterprise SaaS, automation, workflow, iPaaS, or developer platforms preferred.

 - Stay hands-on with frontier models, agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP, etc.), and the evolving tool-use / orchestration landscape.

 - AI literacy in practice, not theory — you use AI-assisted product tools daily for research synthesis, spec drafting, and prototyping.

 - Strong data synthesis instinct: comfortable in SQL/notebooks, translating raw analytics and eval results into strategic decisions.

 - High customer empathy: you do your own user research, run discovery calls, and form opinions from first-hand observation rather than secondhand reports.

 - Excellent stakeholder communication across executives, enterprise buyers, engineers, and researchers.

 - Creative, hacker spirit; love solving puzzles where the right answer didn't exist 12 months ago.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with prompt engineering, evals, or fine-tuning workflows on customer data.

 - Background in BPM, RPA, iPaaS, or enterprise workflow platforms.

 - Domain depth in a regulated vertical (financial services, healthcare, public sector).

 - Second language skills on top of excellent spoken English.

jobs.title: GRC Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION



Technical Program Manager on the UiPath TrustOps team, you will play a hybrid role supporting geographically strategic compliance frameworks and overseeing key national security and regulatory programs in Romania. You will lead the organization’s adherence to industry certifications, regulations, and best practices, while helping manage the requirements associated with UiPath’s Industrial Security Clearance.
This is a role of trust and responsibility. Due to the nature of the position, obtaining a Romanian personnel security clearance is a mandatory prerequisite of employment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH




A. GOVERNANCE, RISK AND COMPLIANCE (GRC)

 - Lead and support geographically strategic compliance frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, and CCPA.

 - Support compliance certification efforts, including executing risk management activities, information security controls, and supporting internal and external audit activities.

 - Develop and maintain a deep understanding of UiPath's control environment and articulate it to various audiences, including internal and external stakeholders and auditors.

 - Establish and enforce global data retention schedules, and implement privacy engineering controls and automations.

 - Maintain UiPath's sub-processor lists and manage the customer notification process.

 - Support the overall data governance and data security strategy.

 - Engage with cross-functional teams to drive the implementation of controls, compliance strategies, and other security-related risk-reduction initiatives.


B.  NATIONAL SECURITY AND REGULATORY PROGRAMS

 - Serve as the accountable owner for obtaining and maintaining UiPath's Industrial Security Clearance.

 - Oversee the establishment and operation of the internal security structure, acting as (or directing) the designated Security Officer (funcționar de securitate) function.

 - Own the PPSIC (Program for Preventing the Leakage of Classified Information) - its elaboration, approval, annual updates, and ongoing application.

 - Direct the implementation and assurance of physical security, personnel security, information security, and INFOSEC measures required for certification, ensuring full compliance with Law 182/2002, HG 585/2002, and HG 781/2002.

 - Oversee the IT system (SIC) authorization process, including the security documentation package (CSSS, Risk Analysis Report, Security Operational Procedures) and the constitution of the CSTIC (IT and Communications Security Component).

 - Act as the primary point of contact with authorities and coordinate any external security consultants, inspections, and audits.

 - Own incident detection and reporting obligations for classified information, and maintain the annual protection-status analysis.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 3–5 years of experience leading geographically strategic compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST R2) and global privacy regulatory requirements such as GDPR and CCPA.

 - Demonstrated ability to own compliance certifications end-to-end, including risk management, control implementation, and audit support.

 - Familiarity with cloud systems including Azure, GCP, and AWS.

 - Proven track record of effectively working with remote teams across different time zones.

 - Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable programs for both technical and executive audiences.

 - Eligibility and willingness to obtain a Romanian personnel security clearance (certificat de securitate / autorizație de acces) as a condition of employment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with Romanian classified information legislation (Law 182/2002, HG 585/2002, and HG 781/2002) and the ORNISS certification landscape.

 - Prior experience holding or managing a national or NATO/EU security clearance.

 - Experience acting as, or working closely with, a designated Security Officer (funcționar de securitate).

 - Knowledge of INFOSEC accreditation processes for classified IT systems (SIC).

 - Working proficiency in Romanian (given the regulatory and governmental interfaces).
